name: progress-pet
description: Motchi automatically matches chat-derived checklist tasks, prioritizes completion evidence and provides a paired Android project dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Your project buddy, a double right-click away
interface.longDescription: Review project checklists with source quotes, history coverage, freshness and Undo for automatic changes. Discuss progress and pending input. Supported approval replies retain the trusted live hook or owned-chat connection; unsupported native cards stay in Codex.
defaultPrompt: Open Motchi and automatically follow my working Codex chats.
Track this project and show me its progress and approval alerts.
